purpose: External-model validation probe for selecting a next experiment; not a student-trained project approach or a held-out test result
cer_policy: NFC; remove U+200B/U+FEFF and all whitespace; punctuation retained
wer_policy: NFC; remove U+200B/U+FEFF; ICU km_KH word breaks; discard punctuation and whitespace segments; corpus edit distance / reference words
subgroup_definition: The mixed group has at least one ASCII letter A-Z/a-z or ASCII digit 0-9 in the reference; all other references are in the second group. Groups were assigned from references only.
notes: The external model was trained by its publisher on DDD Khmer speech. It is not counted among the project's three student-trained approaches.
This score is on validation clips and must not be placed in the held-out test comparison chart.
The author's published CER used a different evaluation set and normalization policy; it is not directly comparable with this result.
